title: What this policy covers
text: This comprehensive motor policy covers loss of or damage to your vehicle from accident, fire, theft and flood, and your legal liability to other people for injury and damage to their property.

title: Reporting a claim
text: You must tell us about any incident that may lead to a claim within 7 days. For theft, you must report to the police within 24 hours and to us within 48 hours.

title: Excess
text: You pay the first 10% of each claim, with a minimum of ₦25,000. The excess does not apply to windscreen claims or to claims where the other driver is fully at fault and identified.

title: Windscreen cover
text: We pay for repairing or replacing broken windscreens and windows up to ₦500,000 per claim. Windscreen claims do not affect your no-claim discount and no excess applies.

title: Documents for accident damage
text: For accident damage, send photos of the damage, your driver's licence, and a repair estimate from an approved garage.

title: Documents for third-party claims
text: For a claim involving another party, send photos, your driver's licence, a police report, and the other party's name, phone number and plate number.

title: Documents for theft
text: For theft, send the police report, both sets of keys, and the vehicle's registration papers and proof of ownership.

title: Approved garages
text: Repairs must be done at one of our approved garages unless we agree otherwise in writing. You can find the nearest approved garage in the app.

title: Courtesy car
text: While your car is being repaired at an approved garage after an accident claim, we provide a courtesy car for up to 10 days.

title: No-claim discount
text: Each year without a claim earns a 10% discount on renewal, up to 50%. A claim reduces the discount by two steps, except windscreen claims.

title: Commercial use and ride-hailing
text: The policy covers private and social use only. Using the vehicle for ride-hailing, delivery or carrying paying passengers is not covered unless you have bought the commercial use endorsement.

title: Drivers
text: Anyone you allow to drive is covered if they hold a valid licence. There is no cover if the driver was unlicensed or under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

title: Flood damage
text: Flood and storm damage is covered. Do not try to start an engine that has been in flood water, as damage caused by starting it is not covered.

title: Injuries to other people
text: We cover your legal liability for injury to other people, including passengers, up to ₦5 million per person. Tell us immediately if anyone is injured.

title: Settlement time
text: Once we have all the documents we need, we aim to approve a claim within 10 working days and pay within 5 working days of approval.

title: Total loss
text: If your car is a total loss or stolen and not recovered within 30 days, we pay its market value at the time of the loss, minus the excess.

title: Cancelling the policy
text: You can cancel at any time. If you have made no claim, we refund the premium for the unused months, minus a ₦10,000 administration fee.

title: Complaints
text: If you are unhappy, contact our complaints team. We will reply within 2 working days and resolve the complaint within 14 days. You can also contact NAICOM.

title: Tracking your claim
text: You can see the status of your claim in the app or by sending STATUS and your claim number on WhatsApp. We send an SMS at each stage.

title: Vehicles used outside Nigeria
text: Cover applies in Nigeria only. Cover in ECOWAS countries is available with an extension bought before you travel.
